# This MiniCluster manifest is designed for a LAMMPS ReaxFF experiment
# on a single AWS ARM-based CPU node within a Kubernetes cluster.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # Using an incrementing name to avoid collisions in a shared environment.
  name: lammps-reax-mc-1
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The size of the MiniCluster, corresponding to the number of pods/nodes.
  # Set to 1 as requested to run on a single node.
  size: 1

  # The Flux Operator will not remove the job stateful set on completion.
  # This is useful for debugging and inspecting logs or output files.
  cleanup: false

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Ensures that any errors in the spec or during execution are fatal.
    strict: true

  # Defines the application container that will run under Flux.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax
      # The command to be executed by Flux. 'flux run' is prepended by the operator.
      # This runs the LAMMPS simulation using the specified input file.
      command: lmp -v x 2 -v y 2 -v z 2 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite

      # Ensures the latest version of the container image is always used.
      imagePullPolicy: Always

      # This container is a worker, not the one launching the job.
      # The operator handles launching from its own pod.
      launcher: false

      # Requesting AWS Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) for high-performance networking.
      resources:
        limits:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: "1"
        requests:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: "1"

  # Flux-specific configuration options.
  flux:
    # Specifies the target architecture for the Flux components.
    # This is required for running on AWS Graviton (ARM) instances.
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      # Disables the sidecar flux-view container. This is a common optimization
      # when the application container has Flux pre-installed or for simpler jobs.
      disable: true
      # Overrides the default Flux container image to use an ARM-compatible version.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-ubuntu:arm-jammy
